critical_issues.description: React 16.11.0 is from 2019 and contains multiple security vulnerabilities. Upgrade to React 18.x for security patches and performance improvements.
cve_references: Multiple XSS vulnerabilities in older React versions

critical_issues.description: React DOM 16.11.0 contains security vulnerabilities. Must be upgraded in sync with React.

high_issues.description: react-scripts 5.0.1 depends on webpack and babel with potential vulnerabilities in transitive dependencies. After React upgrade, rebuild dependencies.
high_issues.recommendation: Update React first, then run npm audit fix
high_issues.notes: Transitive vulnerabilities will be resolved via React dependency chain

high_issues.description: Clarifai 2.9.1 is outdated. Newer versions have security patches and improved API support.
high_issues.notes: Review API documentation for breaking changes before updating

medium_issues.description: Newer versions of react-hot-toast are available with potential bug fixes and security patches.
Package maintainers shifted to 'react-particles' and 'tsparticles'. Current package may have security gaps.
medium_issues.notes: This is a recommended migration path, but current package still works

phase_1.name: Critical React Updates (IMMEDIATE - This Week)
steps: Update React to 18.2.0 and React-DOM to 18.2.0 together
Run npm install to resolve peer dependencies
Verify hooks and component patterns still work correctly

phase_2.name: High Priority Updates (Next Week)
steps: Update react-scripts dependencies via npm audit fix
Update clarifai to latest (6.0.0+) and test API integration

phase_3.name: Medium Priority Updates (Following Week)
steps: Enable GitHub Dependabot for continuous monitoring
Add npm audit to CI/CD pipeline

additional_security_recommendations: Enable GitHub Dependabot in repository settings to get automated security alerts
Set up SECURITY.md file for vulnerability reporting process
Consider adding security scanning tools like Snyk or GitHub CodeQL
Review .env.local and environment variable handling (ensure API keys are never committed)
Add 'npm audit' scanning to pre-commit hooks using husky
Set up branch protection rules to require passing security checks
Enable GitHub Advanced Security features if available
Test thoroughly after any major version updates

github_security_setup.enable_dependabot: Settings > Code security and analysis > Enable Dependabot alerts
github_security_setup.enable_security_scanning: Settings > Code security and analysis > Enable CodeQL analysis
github_security_setup.branch_protection: Settings > Branches > Add rule requiring status checks to pass

next_steps.action: Run npm audit fix for transitive vulnerabilities

summary: This project has 2 CRITICAL vulnerabilities in React and React-DOM that require immediate attention. After upgrading React, run npm audit fix to address transitive dependencies. The Clarifai package is also outdated and should be updated. Enable GitHub Dependabot to maintain security going forward.
